Covers Scotland south of Perth [southern Scotland]. Relief shown by hachures. Title from upper right part of map-content area. Hand colored to emphasize county boundaries. When affixed to the cloth backing the map sheet was sectioned to 20 panels to enable folding. Publisher's printed advert label affixed to cloth backing: Published by William Darton, map-seller, 58 Holborn Hill, London. Includes mileage distance note at upper border and legend titled "Explanation". Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Vault
